jobs.title: Armed Patrol Driver: Retail Security & Quick Response
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Haslet, TX is seeking a Security Officer Armed Patrol Driver for full-time work. Pay: $25.00 per hour; Schedule: Mon–Fri with shifts as listed.

You will provide customer service, respond to incidents (including armed situations as needed), conduct patrols, monitor access, and coordinate with site leadership and emergency responders. Requirements include Level III Armed Certification in Texas, a valid driver’s license, HS diploma, and background/drug screening.
